name: Grisaia no Rakuen -LE EDEN DE LA GRISAIA-
original_name: グリザイアの楽園 -LE EDEN DE LA GRISAIA-
source:
A boy trying to find the paradise he once lost arrived in a secluded garden at the end of the world, where he found five girls. Not knowing himself what the result would be, he took out five seeds and distributed them to the girls, driven by a sense of duty and perhaps even the faintest murmurings of something like hope. One by one, the girls planted the seeds they had been entrusted with in the ground around them, waiting for the day when they would bear fruit.

But whether or not this day will come remains to be seen - everything hinges on one final struggle to learn where a true paradise is to be found.

This story picks up immediately after the events of Grisaia no Meikyuu, with Kazami Yuuji having been detained for suspected involvement with an international terrorist organization, lead by Heath Oslo, that has managed to enter Japan's borders with a devastating new weapon of mass destruction in hand.

The final chapter of the original Grisaia trilogy, featuring Prologue De La Grisaia- a prequel set before Yuuji’s arrival at Mihama Academy; Blanc Aile no Tane- the grand conclusion to the original trilogy (And Rakuen Afterstory- a bonus epilogue to Blanc Aile no Tane, available only in the original 18+ version).
translation:
一名少年為尋找曾經失去的樂園，來到世界盡頭與世隔絕的庭園，在那裡遇見五名女孩。他自己也不知道這樣做會帶來什麼結果，卻在責任感，以及或許連希望都稱不上的微弱心聲驅使下，取出五顆種子，分別交給女孩們。她們把受託的種子一顆顆埋進周圍土壤，等待果實成熟之日。

然而，那一天究竟會不會到來仍是未知數——一切都取決於最後一場戰鬥，以及眾人能否由此找到真正的樂園。

故事緊接《灰色的迷宮》。風見雄二因涉嫌參與希斯．奧斯陸領導的國際恐怖組織而遭到拘留。該組織攜帶破壞力驚人的新型大規模毀滅性武器，成功潛入日本境內。

本作是「灰色」原三部曲最終章，收錄發生在雄二進入美濱學園前的前傳《Prologue De La Grisaia》、為三部曲收尾的《Blanc Aile之種》，以及僅原版18禁版本收錄、作為後者附贈尾聲的《樂園後日談》。
